purpose: Attack the highest-leverage reasons Prometeo is still only parallel rather than self-compounding: strategic self-critique, context retrieval, planner regeneration, historical coverage and unattended event-loop design.
claim_protocol: Use the same exclusive create-if-absent claim root as Q-CANARY-SWARM-01: coordination/opportunities/claims/<opportunity_id>.json. Never overwrite a claim. Losing a race means reload all active canary queues and choose another compatible READY opportunity.
run_protocol: Persist STARTED before substantive work, write only isolated own claim/run/return artifacts, then RETURN and DONE. Shared architecture/authority heads are off-limits.

opportunities.mission: Act as a fresh strategic critic of Prometeo's current route. Load Master Context, User Intent Gap Audit, Strategic Non-Regression/Self-Critique, current Continuity Head, current queues/claims/returns and architecture drafts. Identify the actual throughput bottleneck, any route that is still too conservative/logarithmic, hidden assumptions, and the fastest safe path to demonstrable recursive compounding. Produce specific plan deltas, falsification criteria and what should be stopped/deprioritized. Do not merely summarize existing plans.
opportunities.write_scope: claim + own run + own return only
opportunities.return_contract: A route-change critique with bottleneck, alternative routes, expected compounding leverage, risks, stop-doing list and executable next-wave proposals.

opportunities.mission: Critique CONTEXT_FABRIC_ARCHITECTURE_V1 against current information-retrieval/database/software-engineering practice. Focus on hierarchical summaries/manifests, typed graph, hybrid lexical+vector retrieval, authority/freshness, context receipts, compaction invalidation and role-sensitive context compilation. Identify simpler/faster/better alternatives and concrete implementation choices. Do not assume the parent proposal is correct.
opportunities.write_scope: claim + own run + own return only
opportunities.return_contract: Adversarial technical review + revised candidate architecture + staged implementation/falsification plan.

opportunities.mission: Design the first executable repository Context Fabric prototype: artifact inventory schema, metadata extraction, folder/domain digest generation, typed graph edges, incremental hash invalidation and context receipt output. Reuse current GitHub repository structure and current durable schemas. Produce exact files/scripts/tables to build first, with a smallest end-to-end canary that proves a planner can find critical context without scanning the repo.
opportunities.write_scope: claim + own run + own return only
opportunities.return_contract: Concrete implementation blueprint and canary, including schemas, incremental update algorithm and test cases.

opportunities.mission: Design the shortest operational path from current manually seeded queues to recursive Planner -> Queue -> Workers -> Returns -> Steward -> Planner. Define exactly how returns, proposals, incidents, blockers and strategy-critic findings compile into generation N+1 without human batch design. Include dedup, dependency DAG, risk/critic insertion, stop conditions and evidence of compounding across two generations.
opportunities.write_scope: claim + own run + own return only
opportunities.return_contract: Executable two-generation planner-loop contract and minimal canary path, not just prose architecture.

opportunities.mission: Perform a focused historical Prometeo concept-coverage audit. Find older R-era/FABRIC/Prompt-OS/Book-Canon-Forge/Assembly Surface/Context Foundry/Agent Network concepts that may exist outside the current Master Context. Produce a durable concept ledger with ACTIVE / MERGED / SUPERSEDED / RETIRED_WITH_REASON candidates and exact source refs where available. Do not silently retire anything because it is missing from recent docs.
read_scope: repository historical coordination/docs/source artifacts relevant to Prometeo
opportunities.write_scope: claim + own run + own return only
opportunities.return_contract: Evidence-linked concept ledger candidate + uncovered high-value concepts + integration recommendations.

opportunities.mission: Design the fastest safe external event loop that removes dependence on human `.` turns for monitoring/compilation/projection. Evaluate existing available infrastructure in this project (GitHub Actions, Supabase/Edge/cron/webhooks or combinations) for periodic/event-driven state compilation, stale detection, planner triggers and Live projection. Clearly separate what can run unattended without spawning ChatGPT conversations from what still requires human/platform invocation. Produce a minimal deployable loop and security/authority boundaries.
read_scope: existing Supabase/GitHub runtime files in repository
opportunities.write_scope: claim + own run + own return only
opportunities.return_contract: Minimal external metabolism architecture with concrete trigger schedule/events, state compiler responsibilities, deployment steps, limits and falsification tests.
